title: Michael Shrieve - Wikipedia
notes: Born 6 July 1949, San Francisco, raised in Redwood City; joined Santana at 19 the day he jammed with them; Woodstock 16 August 1969; Santana to Borboletta and Lotus (1969-74); co-wrote four Caravanserai tracks and co-produced it; Automatic Man, Go, Mick Jagger; Rock and Roll Hall of Fame 1998.

title: UltimateSantana: Michael Shrieve
notes: 'a staggering array of complicated, jazz-influenced patterns that not only complemented, but enhanced the syncopated percussion team' (Areas and Carabello); introduced Carlos to Miles Davis and Coltrane (likely).

title: A Breath of Fresh Air: Santana's drummer Michael Shrieve on life, music and beyond (transcript)
notes: 'I started with big band drummers like Buddy Rich and Gene Krupa and then I got into Tony Williams, [Jack DeJohnette], Roy Haynes'; Santana followed him home the night they asked him; 'We played to each other.'

title: Scott K. Fish, Michael Shrieve pt 1 (Modern Drummer interview, July 1983)
notes: Summary page only: 'I see it as a flow of energy. Let's say the rhythm I play contains a flow of energy that isn't locked to the rhythm.'
